lines.en: : *Hic*
: Whadr’ye lookin’ at, Sensei?
: Hey, Molly. I just figured I’d come keep you company since you’re drunk and alone and no one seems to be paying any attention to you.
: Story of my life.
: Where’s Tsuneyo?
: ‘Ell if I know. Probably...bein’ a cat?
: I ever tell you how I feel about cats?
: I don’t think that topic has ever come up before, no.
: How much have you had to drink?
: Yes.
: Well, that more or less answers that.
: Ye want’some, Sensei? Can *hic* finish mine if ye pay me for it.
: Why would I pay you for a half empty beer in a place where I can very likely get as many of them as I want for free?
: ‘Alf empty?...Or 'alf full?
: Do I look like an optimist to you? Of course it’s half empty.
: Ha! Dass...where’yer wrong! I jusssssss...
: Jusss opened this one, idiot.
So, it appears that I may have shown up a bit too late to prevent Molly from slipping into an alcohol induced coma.
Is she still standing right now? Sure. But...there’s no way that’s going to last much longer.
I’m glad she at least decided to drink alone instead of taking Kirin up on her offer, though.
It’s one thing to get blackout drunk, but a completely different thing to get blackout drunk around someone who would likely attempt to [molest] you.
: Where did you even get that? I thought everyone was actively trying to prevent a repeat of last year.
: Obvenously from the *hic* alcohol room.
: Obviously. But that doesn’t explain-
: Sensei. Nooooobody’s tryin’ to stop me from doin’ anything.
: Futaba was.
: She here now? Or is she a...*hic* traitor who left me all alone to go talk to my arch nemesis?
: Rin is your nemesis now?
: Juss look at her! Holdin’ hands with a girl.
: LESBIAN!!!
: GIRL...LIKER!!!
: She’s so *hic* hot...
Well, on the bright side, this time she’s yelling about lesbians and not her father.
That is a step in the right direction.
Or at least...a direction.
I don’t think either one of those things is a particularly good thing to yell about while inebriated beyond belief in a room full of your peers.
But, again, at least she’s standing.
: Molly, I-
: *Hic* Whaaatsyer...problem?
: Why ya just lookin’ at me with those...eyes?
: Can you hear me? I don’t really...know.
: Ay! If you’ve got sometin’ ta say, ye best say it before I start yellin’!
: Everything is better where it’s dark. You’re already yelling, though.
: GO! RUN! I just wanted to know what-
/////////////////////////SUCCESSFULLY CONNECTED TO “HALLOWEEN SPECIAL”
/////////////////////////CHECKING FOR FLAG “mollyhalloween2win”
/////////////////////////ACCESSING ADDITIONAL PROFILE INFORMATION
/////////////////////////PLEASE TAKE YOUR TIME IN FAMILIARIZING YOURSELF WITH THIS INFORMATION
/////////////////////////MOLLY MACCORMACK IS A [[MANDATORY] ROMANCEABLE CHARACTER
/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO RAISE YOUR AFFECTION WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK
/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO SPEND TIME WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK
/////////////////////////CONNECTION TERMINATED
: Really, though! Who the *hic* heck do they think they are?!
: What is this? A love hotel? Have some tact!
: They’re just...holding hands.
: I know! Disgusting, right?! In a place like *hic* this. The nerve!
: To be fair, the two of them are dating now and, if they want to hold hands in public, it’s well within their right to do so.
: Sounds to me like we got...*hic*...an imposter in our midst.
: ...What?
: You got ta nerve...ta come over ta me...and not be on my side? Whaddya tink tis is? AMOGUS?!
: I...have no idea what you’re talking about.
: Cause ya never try ta learn! All ya do is sit in your fancy office chair, eat hot chip, and lie!
: How have you gotten drunker by just...standing there and not drinking?
: I had a whole other *hic* beer while you were starin’ off inta space!
: Ya see anytin’ out there, Sensei?! ‘Dya find Haruka’s husband?!
: When was I staring off into space?
: Unbelievable! Kids these days! Always on their phones and not even payin’ attention to ta world around ‘em.
: You are...not one to speak.
: And now yer takin’ me freedom of speech?!
: Somebody ping the mods!
: Okay, you know what? I’m going to be a responsible adult and confiscate that beer from-
: Okay, you know what? Let’s distract you from drinking anymore by talking more about Rin and Otoha.
: *Hic*
: I shoulda never came to this party.
: Nobody wants ta talk to me when they’ve gotta burn their feet on coals ta do it.

: S’one ting ta have Futaba ditch me for ‘er best friend, but th’rest o’ta manga club’s too’fraid ta’proach me while we’ve got Little Miss PDA and her super hot girlfriend makin’ hand sex at the table.
: Please don’t call holding hands “hand sex.” It makes me feel strange.
: If it makes you feel strange, imagine how I feel!
: S’like when ya die to th’frickin’ dance on Council of Blood and have to sit there watchin’ everyone else boogie down while ya ask yer death knight for a b-res!
: S’like pingin’ for your jungler to gank mid because ‘yer getting ‘yer arse handed to ya, but he’s too busy campin’ top because that’s where ‘is friend is laning!
: S’like when Genji asks you to nano boost ‘im but then dives in and get’s ‘is arse flash-fanned by McCree!
: Oh, sorry- Cole frickin’ Cassidy’s ‘is name now because Blizzard’s conflict resolution team’s run by a’bunch’a monkeys.
Molly is so drunk at this point that she has begun making up words and people and...I really have no idea how to handle it.
: I’m sure it doesn’t feel great being you right now, but...
: But what, Sir? What can ya possibly say right now tat’ll make me feel any better?
: You know, I probably should have thought of that before speaking because I’ve honestly got nothing.
: But hey. I’m here. And I’ve been diffusing problems left and right since I showed up.
This obviously isn’t true since I’ve been tossed into four or five of them at this point and really haven’t resolved any.
But Molly doesn’t need to know that.
She just needs someone to lean on.
Literally, because she is going to fall over any minute now.
: Hah...yeah...you’re here.
: But so am I. And that’s exactly the problem, Sensei.
: Go back to calling me Sir, please. Hearing you say “Sensei” repeatedly is somehow the weirdest part of all of this to me.
: I’ll try, Sir. But I can barely feel me face right now.
: Like...look!
: Is she tryin’ to make me jealous or d’she literally forget I exist? Which one is it, Sir?!
: ...Neither?
: She’s just enjoying herself with her new girlfriend.
: I wanna be the new girlfriend...
: You’re not even succeeding at being Molly right now.
: You drank yourself into a stupor to avoid having to deal with your problems because you can’t play video games right now and are handling the consequences of that decision by just...complaining.
: Sounds pretty familiar to me, Sir.
: Nothin’ says the Emerald Guardian like hidin’ your problems behind other stuff while *hic* shummle...taneously complainin’ about ‘em.
: Simultaneously.
: You’re not smarter than me!
: Maybe not, but I am sober- which allows me to do this thing where I say words correctly.
: You’ve been on my case ta whole night! Why aren’t ya makin’ me feel better?!
: What do you want me to do? Go force Rin to talk to you?
: The last time we tried that, she not only made you cry, but made me sit there holding her arm closed so she didn’t bleed out.
: Bet her new girlfriend doesn’t even know about that yet.
: F’I know Rin, she’s just gonna hide it and hide it and hide it and pretend everyting’s okay ‘til she gets caught.
: S’what she always does. I know ‘er better t’en I know meself.
: That checks out. Because pretending everything is okay until you get caught is exactly what you did concerning your feelings for her, isn’t it?
: Ah-
: Oh.
: Please don’t cry.
: That was so mean!
: It wasn’t meant to be mean. I’m just pointing out how you and Rin aren’t that different-
: I know that, Sir! Why do you think I like her so much?!
: Molly, I know you’re drunk, but someone is going to hear you if you keep yelling like that.
: Let ‘em! S’not like t’ey care anyway!
: Of course they do. They...probably just don’t want to spend a night that is supposed to be fun consoling a drunken girl who’s still pining after a friend in a relationship.
: You are on her side...
: Molly, there are no sides. You’re both [teenager]s with little to no impulse control who are going to get hurt and make stupid decisions because that is the part of life you’re in right now.
: I’m just trying to avoid you making things worse than they already are, which, judging by the condition you’re in and the literal tears in your eyes, is pretty bad.
: L-Leave me alone!
: Molly, come on.
: I’m...going home!
: You can barely stand up.
: I’m fine!
: You! Butler! Hold my potion!
: Molly, that’s-
: Not a butler...
: Don’t follow me!
: Do you have any idea how many hallways this place has? No one will ever see you again.
: Well maybe things are *hic* better that way!
: Molly, come-
: Goodbye forever!
: Hah...
Molly opens up some door near the back of the room and disappears inside.
Not only am I thankful that she didn’t elect to turn into the hall of many halls (The cool name I’ve decided to give to Ayane’s maze thing), but I’m glad she’s going to be alone for a while.
Granted, she’s been alone ever since Futaba left her side- but still.
She’s safer locked away in some room than out in the open, screaming about how mean I am and how her friend should be dating her instead.
But, at the same time, thousands of people die every year by choking on their vomit after passing out drunk.
Probably.
That’s not a real statistic, but it sounds believable enough and I know for a fact that it does happen sometimes.
Damn it. Where’s Tsuneyo?
: Go to her.
: Uta?
: N...Nyaa~
: How much of that did you hear?
: Enough to know that you hurt Molly’s feelings.
: Thankfully, she won’t remember that I hurt her feelings because of how drunk she is.
: You should still go to her, Sensei.
: Even if it wasn’t on purpose, you made her cry. So now it’s your job to make her feel better.
: What are you even doing over here? I thought you were playing a game with Nodoka and company.
: We were.
: Well...we are.
: Which is...
: Nyaa...
: I don’t speak cat.
: Just...go check on her.
: I’ll make sure no one gets in the way.
: You...definitely attracted some attention with Molly’s yelling...and...my group was kind of already looking over here, so...
: Do you want to come with me?
: Nyaa?
: ...Is that a yes or?
: Why would I come?
: Just had a feeling you might want to.
: You should go alone.
: Wipe that frown off of Molly’s face! And make sure she drinks some water while you’re at it!
: Hah...fine.
: But the second she starts accusing me of taking sides again, I’m coming back out here and hanging out with you instead.
: Nyahaha! You may think that, but the truth is that I’m far too cool for you, Sensei!
: You’ll be forced to sit with your [niece] and her friends instead!
: But things got weird there last time...
: Don’t wanna hear it, mister! Your time with Uta-nyan has expired!
: If you’d like to proceed with the conversation, please give her six billion yen.
: Why the hell have your rates gone up so much?
: Hmmm...the whiskers, probably?
: Now go! Go go go go go! Make the Irish girl smile and you'll get free flavor beams for the next month!
: Say no more. I’m going.
: Heheh...
: See you later, Sensei...
I make my way across the hall and look back to find Uta explaining to a few of the other girls what’s going on.
Well, it’s probably something closer to attempting to explain what is going on since I, a person who was there for the entire exchange, do not fully understand.
So, let’s recap what I do know.
Molly is drunk.
Molly is mad at me.
Molly is mad at virtually everything.
Molly is also sad.
Her costume is very tight.
I want to take her costume off.
Molly is crying.
I want to take her costume off.
No one is coming to the room.
Molly is drunk.
I want to take her costume off.
I am walking.
I am using my feet to walk toward Molly.
Molly is drunk.
I want to take her costume off.
Molly won’t remember anything.
Molly is sad.
Molly wants to be loved.
Molly wants to be touched.
I want to touch Molly.
I want to take her costume off.
I want to take her costume off.
I want to fuck her.
I shouldn’t fuck her.
Molly is drunk.
I want to fuck Molly.
Molly is mad.
Molly is mad at me.
I want to take her costume off.
No one is coming to the room.
I am here.
I have found Molly.
I want to make her feel better.
I came here to make Molly feel better.
Molly is crying.
Molly is drunk.
I am a good person.
I am a good person.
I am.
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]! I want to take her costume off.
